hints.title: Consecutive Character Run Alignment
hints.text: Every character of the original name must appear in typed in the exact same relative order, possibly with duplicate repeated keys.

hints.title: Two String Pointer Step
hints.text: Advance both pointers when characters match. If characters differ, typed character must match the preceding typed character.

hints.title: Full Consumption Check
hints.text: After processing typed string, ensure the entire name was consumed and all trailing characters in typed continue matching the final character.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Single pass scanning typed characters with name pointer.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Run-length encoding string splits take extra memory and multiple passes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use two pointers to match characters and permit repeated key presses.
